findings.title: Public-facing routers rely only on Cloudflare Access; `ntfy-auth` is dead config
evidence: config/traefik/dynamic.yml:26 defines middleware `ntfy-auth`; no router references it
config/traefik/dynamic.yml — only `falcon-ntop` uses `falcon-basic-auth`; other public routers have no origin auth
docs/security/SECURITY_DOCTRINE.md / Access export — Cloudflare Access is the only gate for the public dashboards
findings.impact: If Cloudflare Access is misconfigured or bypassed, the origin Traefik routers serve dashboards without an independent auth check; the unused middleware misleads reviewers into believing ntfy is protected.
findings.recommendation: Add origin authentication to public routers (or record a testable owner acceptance); delete or wire `ntfy-auth`.
findings.note: Carried from focused run SEC-P2-001; not yet fixed at f9cb67d.

findings.title: All 20 inherited credentials remain PENDING rotation; 28 vendored scripts source credential files wholesale
evidence: docs/security/INHERITED_CREDENTIAL_ROTATION.md:91 rotation_status.py on the real tracker: 20 items, 0 rotated, 20 pending
docs/security/INHERITED_CREDENTIAL_ROTATION.md:69-75 28 scripts under mct/scripts/ and mct/deploy-scripts/ still `set -a; source ops/creds.env`
findings.impact: No completed rotation evidence exists for the inherited estate, so any pre-existing disclosure of these secrets is still live; whole-file sourcing exposes every key to each script's process environment.
findings.recommendation: Execute the documented rotation order with name-only evidence and negative tests; migrate the 28 scripts to single-key reads.
findings.note: Tooling (rotation_status.py) added earlier; rotation execution itself remains outstanding.

report:
Read-only review of the security/authn surface at `f9cb67d`: Traefik dynamic routing (`config/traefik/dynamic.yml`), the inherited-credential rotation tracker, and the secret-scanning configuration. Reconciled against the focused lens run `falcon-20261004-0700-main-ff868e5` and the 2026-10-03 full-domain run.

- `git grep ntfy-auth` shows `config/traefik/dynamic.yml:26` defines `ntfy-auth` but no router uses it; only `falcon-ntop` carries `falcon-basic-auth`.
- `docs/security/INHERITED_CREDENTIAL_ROTATION.md:7,91` still records `20/20 PENDING`; `automation/validation/rotation_status.py` prints `20 items, 0 rotated, 20 pending` against the real tracker.
- `.gitleaks.toml` now anchors the curl-auth-user allowlist to runtime-variable/placeholder values (SEC-001 fix retained).

No secrets were printed; only names/hashes were read.
